query:
SELECT id, name, 
  JSON_LENGTH(certifications) as cert_count,
  LEFT(certifications, 200) as cert_preview,
  LEFT(sustainable_alternatives, 100) as sustain_preview
FROM plants 
WHERE id = 30010;
